quotes.text:
58) LOBSTERS🦞

The Japanese spiny lobster is better known as 'Ise-ebi' (イセエビ), named after one of the few places they are caught in Japan.
Okage-yokochō (おかげ横丁), a shopping street that leads to Ise Jingū's (伊勢神宮) inner shrine, sells these adorable lobster omikuji🥰

［Diary］Sun/Jul.26/2026
My family and I visited Ise and Shima. My son who loves trains, was thrilled to take the Ise Shima Liner to get there. After checking into a hotel, we headed to the Yokoyama Viewing Platform to admire the stunning scenery of Ago Bay. I was delighted that the weather was sunny.

Exactly! They are very strict about the date because it’s so fresh. 😆

Ise and the Shima Peninsula are beautiful. If you ever go, you can visit the Ise Grand Shrine and see the 'Meoto Iwa' (the Wedded Rocks) in the ocean. I hope you get to visit someday!

Blue on Blue. 🚙💙

Taking the Honda CR-Z for a run on the Ise-Shima Skyline in Mie, Japan. The view from the top is absolutely breathtaking. Nothing beats a drive under a sky like this.
